responsibility: Declares the MIR interpreter module structure and reexports the public interpreter API, assembling the context, machine, memory, operand/place, validation, and execution components into the `interpret` interface used by CTFE and related clients.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `const_eval/mod.rs`, which packages const-evaluation queries and CTFE-specific helpers, this `mod.rs` is the lower-level interpreter root that assembles and reexports the general MIR execution machinery—contexts, memory, operands/places, intrinsics, stepping, and validity support. Unlike `transform/mod.rs` or `transform/check_consts/mod.rs`, it provides the execution substrate itself rather than transform-pass organization or const-legality checking.
